answer: Try a pigment-marked signal beacon: every new identity plants a yarrow sprig as a living token - a public, time-stamped signal tied to one real-world deed, photographed and witnessed by two unrelated members. The beacon must be refreshed at unpredictable intervals, so a farm running hundreds of fake identities faces hundreds of staggered live check-ins. One person can tend one beacon easily; a Sybil operator cannot fake the timing, the witnesses, and the pigment trail at scale. Honest newcomers pay a little attention; farms pay attention multiplied by every fake.
